reviews.t: Great mirror for a fair price!
reviews.x: Like another reviewer, I purchased this mirror after seeing one that is identical to it on QVC for $50! The $20 price point is much more appropriate for the quality of the mirror. The mirror base is plastic, but not cheap looking. I like how the lights gradually turn on and off, nice effect. It also allows you to adjust the brightness of the lighting. The small magnification mirror detaches and is handy for doing your eye makeup.  Overall, a great mirror for a fair price! I use it daily!

I really like the quality of this mirror. I had been looking for something on my dresser to help with makeup application and eyebrow tweezing and this is great. It holds a charge, is nice and bright, and it also looks nice. I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for an LED mirror!

I had to use the little magnification mirror all the time though to be able to see well enough to apply makeup.  It also runs down fairly quickly and takes a long time to re-charge.  I had to plug it in each day when we arrived at the hotel to be able to have enough power for the next morning.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the mirror as a great value at an affordable price.
Many reviewers love the bright, adjustable/dimmable LED lighting.
Several reviewers appreciate the cordless rechargeable design and not needing batteries, though some report the charge does not last or the unit stops holding a charge.
Reviewers like the included magnetic 5x magnifying mirror and the mirror's sturdy, attractive build.
A few reviewers report the mirror stopped working after a short time, while others praise responsive customer service and warranty replacement.
